title: Sorry, haters. Ferrari’s first EV is doing just fine | TechCrunch
summary: When Ferrari revealed the Luce — its first EV — to the public in May, the internet reacted. Ferrari hit this year’s sales target for the Luce in just two months, according to a report by the Financial Times.
